rachats.citation: In November 2020 WTW acquired Acclimatise, a UK-based climate consultancy
in November 2021 it agreed to acquire Israeli broker Leaderim as part of a broader build-out of specialty and regional broking networks
In July 2022 WTW acquired Butterwire, a climate risk analytics firm
In January 2026, it was announced that WTW had acquired Invoice Cover, a Quebec-based specialist in trade credit insurance (completed December 2025)
In January 2026, WTW acquired the American company Newfront in a $1.3 billion deal

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
